responsibility: Specializes the rs6000 AIX target for AIX 7.1. It supplies option-override policy, assembler CPU mapping specs, predefined OS macros, default processor choices, startfile/lib/link specs, wchar_t and ptrdiff_t definitions, DWARF defaults, and AIX 7.1 feature enablement such as VSX/Altivec availability, making it the version-specific subtarget header layered on top of generic AIX support.
